verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents native integrations that collect compliance data automatically from connected systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP. It says this data satisfies evidence requests and feeds continuous monitors, and that refreshes run up to daily or ad-hoc, which covers automatic, scheduled collection. The evidence never describes the resulting artifacts as timestamped or explicitly says they replace screenshots and CSV uploads, and the support is mostly marketing-level. Missing for 10: documented timestamped, machine-gathered evidence artifacts; explicit replacement of manual screenshot/CSV uploads; configurable collection schedules beyond 'up to daily'; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, evidence is collected automatically from connected systems on a schedule — screenshots and CSV exports are replaced by timestamped, machine-gathered artifacts

citations.quote: Thoropass collects compliance-relevant data automatically, keeping you audit-ready and alerting you to compliance violations
High-quality data automatically satisfies evidence requests while powering transparent continuous compliance monitors.
Monitors automatically check your connected systems (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP) for compliance with the control's requirements.
Monitors and integrations will be refreshing data up to daily or ad-hoc
